## Description

Confirms certification transferability on change of control against the actual certifying body's own rules — inference is explicitly disallowed (design's non-negotiable rule, restated in `checklists/brownfield-feasibility-checklist.yaml` bf-03 and `checklists/ma-special-topics-checklist.yaml` ma-12, which requires this check LAST in the M&A evaluation sequence, since a non-transferable certification can strip the premium a valuation already assumed). Use when: "certification transferability", "change of control certification", "certification survives acquisition".
